استأتيت (form X)
# اِسْتَأْتَيْتُ (istaʔtaytu) /is.taʔ.taj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَأْتَى (istaʔtā)
# اِسْتَأْتَيْتَ (istaʔtayta) /is.taʔ.taj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَأْتَى (istaʔtā)
# اِسْتَأْتَيْتِ (istaʔtayti) /is.taʔ.taj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَأْتَى (istaʔtā)
